svg.title: Placement Tradeoffs
svg.desc: Every placement changes what fits. I compare a fast greedy choice, a bounded genetic search, and an exhaustive reference. The drawing shows the tighter-deadline fixture, where only Edge with 6 capacity units is eligible: greedy places request C in 5 units for objective 23, while genetic search and the exhaustive reference place D and E in 6 units for objective 27.
